runs.code:
import pandas as pd

def read(path):
 return pd.read_csv(path, comment='#')
for lake,path in [('wingra','task1_data_and_tasks/data/wingra.csv'),('mendota','task1_data_and_tasks/data/mendota.csv')]:
 d=read(path); print(lake,d.head(),d.columns)
 d['timestamp']=pd.to_datetime(d['timestamp'])
 # Wingra calendar Jul22; Mendota v1 observation day Jul22 = timestamps Jul22 08 through Jul23 07:59
 start='2026-07-22 00:00' if lake=='wingra' else '2026-07-22 08:00'
 end='2026-07-23 00:00' if lake=='wingra' else '2026-07-23 08:00'
 x=d[(d.timestamp>=start)&(d.timestamp<end)&(d.water_temp_qc==0)]
 print(lake,len(x),x.water_temp_C.mean(),x[['timestamp','water_temp_C','water_temp_qc']].to_string(index=False))
